description: This file is a shell script used for testing Git behaviors related to remote push rejections. It defines test cases to verify that push errors are correctly reported by the client.

methods.name: test_hook
methods.description: Sets up a hook to simulate rejection behavior during Git operations.

methods.name: test_expect_success
methods.description: Defines a test case expecting successful execution.

methods.name: test_must_fail
methods.description: Runs a command expecting it to fail.

methods.name: grep
methods.description: Searches for rejected references in error output.
